properties.name: sbp.gateway.port
properties.description: HTTP port for the API gateway. Overridden by env GATEWAY_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.services.auth.url
properties.description: Base URL of the auth service (Docker or localhost). Overridden by env AUTH_SERVICE_URL.

properties.name: sbp.services.user.url
properties.description: Base URL of the user service. Overridden by env USER_SERVICE_URL.

properties.name: sbp.internal-api.base-path
properties.description: Reserved base path for internal gateway APIs.

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Public API base path for the gateway.
